company.name: Onefinance
company.shortDescription: Onefinance is a consumer finance company offering an integrated platform for saving, spending, and growing money.
company.description: Onefinance operates as a consumer finance company. It offers an innovative after pay experience through an integrated consumer financing platform. The company's services aim to enhance financial inclusion and expand consumer finance solutions. Onefinance's platform allows customers to save, spend, and grow their money all in one place. The company also issues a ONE card, which is licensed by Mastercard® International, providing customers with a convenient payment solution.
